ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Huge Things
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Huge plants and huge animals that behave like their size. Mass has consequences.
The engine gives every plant and every pawn one cell, however big it is drawn. A mushroom twenty cells across can only be clicked on the cell it grows from, pawns walk straight through its stem, and walls get built inside it. A beast the size of a house walks through a doorway, hides behind a sandbag and gets penned like a chicken.
Huge Things fixes that for anything that opts in:
- A huge PLANT gets a solid trunk. The cells where its art touches the ground are solid (measured per species, and grown into as the plant grows), so pawns walk around it and nothing can be built inside it. You still walk under its cap. Clicking anywhere on its picture selects it. Trunks give partial cover, and shots into them hurt the plant. - A huge ANIMAL gets a selection hitbox the size of its drawn body. - A TITAN (any creature of body size 4 or more, or one a mod opts in) gets a size tier. Heavy, colossal and titanic creatures crush crates and plants, breach walls, hole thin roofs and leave rubble as they walk, struggle under overhead mountain, butcher for a curved yield, and the largest leave a corpse that becomes a harvest site worked over days. - The biggest titans smash through giant plants, damaging them as they push past; smaller titans go around the trunks like walls.
With Large Pawns (neku.largepawns) loaded, titans also occupy 2x2 to 4x4 cells, using this mod's tiers; without it they stay one cell and everything else still works.
Mod Settings: one master switch for giant plants and one for giant animals, each with every detailed behaviour and its tuning beneath. All off is vanilla.
This is the engine only. A plant opts in with the RM_HugePlantExtension, a race with the RM_HugePawnExtension or RM_TitanicExtension modExtension (or simply a large enough body size). This mod replaces "RimMandrake: Titanic Creatures" (mandrake.rm.titaniccreatures), which is now part of it.
